svg.text: Built from CSAT, competitor analysis, crazy 8s and the lo-fi discussion.
A shortcut to products, with order info behind the bell.
Auto-shuffling banners that flex to the number of promos.
Every product category in one horizontal row.
The most-requested home feature in the CSAT survey.
Digital products grouped, so no team fights for the top slot.
Warung-wide news moved into its own banner slot.
Best-sellers in a horizontal slider, WPD and Grosir tagged.
History moved out, so the bar drops from five tabs to four.
